sourceFindings: 2021 requires one writing response, not two. The total is 315: 120+40+50+60+45. The notice and both stories each stay whole; the letter has two recipient routes.
All 14 listening tasks are exact-answer 0/full-mark awards. Do not copy 2022 partial-credit exceptions.

Q3A(4) explicitly permits 6,4 or3 marks depending on the wording; keep every listed answer and permitted marks [0,3,4,6]. Q3C(5) gives 6 for An aois and 4 for the specified two-line overquotations; permitted marks [0,4,6]. Carry these rules into paired reading routes.
Q3B(5) accepts Clárú isteach, Clárú and the published longer quotations for 6 marks. These are accepted answers, not task-selection pools.

4A is the basketball marathon notice with Derval O’Rourke and sports equipment. Layout1; picture1=10(5+5),picture2=13(5+4+4),picture3=5,picture4=5,shared Gaeilge11. There is no admission-price question. Preserve the explicit activity/place partial credit, date deductions and -4 for an uncontextualized guest name.

4B is a seaside holiday-house letter to a brother or sister in Canada. Each recipient route retains all four pictures and requirements, six layout marks, four seven-mark content awards (4+3) and one shared eleven-mark language award. No letter length deduction.
2021 language bands: Sármhaith9–11,An-mhaith7–8,Maith5–6,Maith go leor3–4,Lag2,An-lag1,Easnamhach0. Do not copy the different 2022 or 2023 tables.

5A is Béárbaiciú sa Bhaile, scheme PDF13–14. 5B is the shopping-centre/pet-shop incident, scheme PDF14–16. Both have communication34 and language11, minus4 per missing reference within communication; approximately90words and length table80–90:0,60–79:-2,30–59:-3,<30:-4. 5B needs a reference to each of four pictures plus a fifth. There is no conflicting -5 reference line in this year.
The poem Cuairt ar an Áiléar is three stanzas. Retain it in full with every passage, map, sign grid and writing picture sequence. Scheme transcripts PDF18–20 are answer material.
